newsitem.title: QATAR: Banks lead Qatar shares up one percent in the week.
newsitem.headline: Banks lead Qatar shares up one percent in the week.

text.p: Solid gains by banks at Qatar's official stock exchange pushed the share index up more than one percent to 137.43 points in the week to Thursday, dealers said.

The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 17-share index closed 1.61 point higher than the previous week's 135.82 points, mainly on the back of a 10-riyal rise in the shares of Qatar National Bank, which accounts for a third of total market capitalisation.

Jamal Rihawi, information officer at the official Doha Securities Market, said the value of banks shares traded during the week stood at four million riyals ($1.1 million), of which QNB accounted for over 2.77 million riyals.
QNB shares traded 10 riyals higher at 590.
During the week, 34,780 shares changed hands -- 12 percent more than the previous week's 30,891 shares. In terms of value traded, banks took the lead with 10,354 shares valued at four million riyals.
They were followed by services with 23,385 shares valued at 2.6 million riyals and industrials with 1,050 shares valued at 117,550 riyals.
Major gainers were the Commercial Bank of Qatar, which jumped 15 riyals to 330, Qatar Leisure, which gained five riyals to 52 and Qatar Real Estate, which added two riyals to 60.
Doha Bank Ltd gathered one riyal to 326, while Qatar Shipping shed half a riyal to 47.50.
